question_en: What does it mean for a model to be overfitted?
question_de: Was bedeutet es, wenn ein Modell überangepasst ist?
reference_answer: It fits the training data very well but performs poorly on new data, having memorised noise rather than the underlying structure.
gold_evidence: wenn es die Trainingsdaten sehr gut abbildet

question_en: What is the difference between training error and validation error called?
question_de: Wie bezeichnet man den Abstand zwischen Trainings- und Validierungsfehler?

question_en: Into which terms can the expected error of a model be decomposed?
question_de: In welche Teile lässt sich der erwartete Modellfehler aufspalten?
reference_answer: Bias squared plus variance plus irreducible noise.

question_en: What kind of model has high bias?
question_de: Welche Modelle haben eine große Verzerrung?
reference_answer: A model that is too simple (underfitting).
gold_evidence: zu einfaches Modell hat eine hohe Verzerrung

What does ridge regularization add to the loss function?
question_de: Welchen Term ergänzt die Ridge-Regression in der Verlustfunktion?
reference_answer: The squared sum of the weights, penalising large weights.
gold_evidence: Addiert die quadrierte Summe der Gewichte

question_en: Which hyperparameter controls how strongly the weights are penalized?
question_de: Mit welchem Hyperparameter stellt man die Stärke der Bestrafung ein?

question_en: How does lasso differ from ridge regularization?
question_de: Worin unterscheidet sich Lasso von Ridge?
reference_answer: Lasso sets individual weights exactly to zero, which performs automatic feature selection.
gold_evidence: einzelne Gewichte exakt auf null gesetzt

question_en: With what probability are neurons usually switched off in dropout?
question_de: Wie hoch ist bei Dropout typischerweise die Wahrscheinlichkeit, ein Neuron abzuschalten?

question_en: Is dropout used at test time?
question_de: Wird Dropout auch beim Testen verwendet?
reference_answer: No, dropout is switched off during testing.

question_en: When does early stopping end training?
question_de: Wann bricht Early Stopping das Training ab?
reference_answer: When the validation error stops decreasing over several epochs.

question_en: Which derivation will be on the exam?
question_de: Welche Herleitung kommt in der Klausur dran?
reference_answer: The derivation of the bias-variance decomposition.
